name: Marksman’s Ring
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Slot ring; Price 32,000 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

The marksman’s ring improves the wearer’s accuracy and efficiency when using any type of projectile or thrown missile weapon with which he is proficient, granting a +2 competence bonus to attack and damage rolls for these weapons.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring, Throw Anything, cat’s grace, caster must be proficient with at least one simple ranged weapon, one martial ranged weapon and one exotic ranged weapon; Cost 16,000 gp

Identification DC 18
